text:
sudha: heads-up — on thalia-embed v1 we saw a surprising recall@10 drop after int8 quant. holdout wiki_small went from 0.81 -> 0.75. :eyes:
anya: ouch, that's pretty big. which eval run / seed? any config diffs?
devin: quick summary from the job:
```
cmd: python eval/recall.py --model thalia-v1 --quant int8 --k 10 --holdout wiki_small --seed 42
float recall@10: 0.812
int8  recall@10: 0.752
samples: 10k
```
devin: same batchsize, same whitening. just switched to static per-channel quant from symmetric per-tensor.
sudha: added the UMAP from the int8 vectors here — https://intra.redwood/umap/3801239999.png — clusters look stretched along one axis.
anya: can you dump a few neighbor lists? maybe neighbourhood flip rate high?
devin: pasted a tiny diff of neighbors (float -> int8):
```
query: "how to reset password"
float top3: [docA, docB, docC]
int8  top3: [docX, docB, docA]
flip: 2/3
```
mike: two quick suspects: 1) scale mismatch (L2 norm) before quantization, 2) K-values in PQ/OPQ if any. did we calibrate per-channel zeros properly?
sudha: we used the offline calibrator with default 256 bins. i can rerun with per-channel symmetric+hist equalization.
anya: also try preserving float L2 norm (normalize post-quant) — reminds me of that centroid drift bug.
devin: scheduled two jobs: per-channel-int8+hist-eq and per-tensor-int8+norm. starting now. job ids: 87921, 87922.
eval-bot: job 87921 finished — recall@10 = 0.781 (delta -0.031 vs float).
eval-bot: job 87922 finished — recall@10 = 0.805 (delta -0.007 vs float).
anya: wow per-tensor+norm looks promising. can we repro on the larger wiki_holdout?
devin: queued both on wiki_full overnight. will also run embedding distance distributions (cosine) and KNN ID flip rate.
mike: if per-tensor+norm holds up, we should update the quant recommendation for thalia-v1 and add a pre-normalize step in the ingestion. also add a quick unit test in the eval harness for topk flip rate > 0.05 fail.
sudha: agree. i'll make a PR to the onboarding checklist and add the UMAP link + short note about normalization.
anya: thanks all. followups — can someone post the KNN flip script? devin?
devin: here: `scripts/knn_flip.py --float float_embs.npy --quant int8_embs.npy --k 10 --out flips.csv`
sudha: assigning action items: devin re-run large holdout + flip stats, mike update onboarding doc, anya add eval test. i'll file a tiny ticket for rollout holdback if regression persists.
anya: :thumbsup:
